intent: Continue a physical action through one cut without reanalyzing source footage.

continuity_anchor.vehicle_and_props: Preserve rigid prop geometry and contact points.
continuity_anchor.environment: Preserve weather, screen direction, and spatial anchors.
continuity_anchor.camera_geometry: Preserve lens family and camera-to-subject geometry.

shots.subject: The established subject remains screen-left.
shots.camera: Matched-speed tracking with directional motion blur.
shots.audio: Road ambience and one contact transient; no dialogue.

shots.subject: The same visible subject state resolves the action.
shots.action: Consequence settles into a recovery hold.
shots.lighting: The same light direction and exposure continue.

negative_constraints: no generated text, logos, subtitles, UI, or watermarks
